proofs.text: Run `--gate recorded --ci github --upstream-check` and verify the workflow contains `upstream-check:` and `schedule:`; run `--gate recorded` without the flag and verify `upstream-check:` is absent

rule_text: `--upstream-check` adds the scheduled job that watches the pins, and without the flag that job is absent

tests.body:
def test_upstream_check_adds_the_scheduled_job(self, project):
        project.run('--gate', 'recorded', '--ci', 'github',
                    '--upstream-check')
        workflow = read(project.path('.github/workflows/purlin.yml'))
        assert 'upstream-check:' in workflow
        assert 'schedule:' in workflow
tests.name: test_upstream_check_adds_the_scheduled_job
